description: A bearded sea god's head from the front with flowing hair, a thick moustache and a long wavy beard, beside an upright three-pronged trident standing at the right.
A standing sea god in a robe wearing a crown, one arm lowered across his body and the other gripping an upright three-pronged trident held vertically at the right.
A round-bottomed potion flask with a short narrow neck and a rimmed stopper at the top, and a wavy liquid line across the upper half of the bulb.
A hero's bust from the front: short swept hair with a fringe falling to the left, a domino mask across the eyes, and sloping shoulders with a V-shaped collar.
A cyborg bust from the front: a rounded helmet with a horizontal visor band across the eyes, an exposed mouth and chin below, a neck line and broad sloping shoulders.
A round robot-cat face inside a larger circle: two eyes set close together at the top, a round nose, whisker dashes on each side, and a wide open smile.
A mecha from the front: a head with a tall V-shaped antenna crest and a top fin, a helmeted face with a chin vent, and two blocky shoulder armour pieces; dense and hard to read.
A round spiked mine: a ring-shaped body with eight triangular spikes evenly spaced around its outline, and a smaller circle at its centre.
A person's head and shoulders from the front, with five short rays fanning out above and around the head — one vertical and two diagonal on each side.
A pendant hanging from a large teardrop loop cord: a round medallion at the bottom with a small square gem set in its centre.
A group of three people from the front — a larger central figure flanked by two smaller ones behind — with a three-pointed crown floating above the central figure's head.
A group of three people from the front, a central figure flanked by two others, with a pennant flag on a pole rising above the upper left.
A front-facing girl's head with two round hair buns on top, long pigtails falling down both sides, a fringe with a small tiara point, dot eyes and a smile.
An empty burst-shaped speech bubble with a wavy spiked outline, surrounded by short straight action lines radiating outward on all sides.
